$comment: One entry per distinct PAGE SHAPE, re-derived from the real page files (src/pages/**). Every real route maps to exactly one template. Slots: required / repeatable / variants (the content.variant values allowed in that slot; 'default' = the homepage branch with no variant field) / alternatives (a CHOICE slot: exactly one of the slot or an alternative). Chrome (nav, footer CTA block, footer) is rendered once by src/components/Layout.jsx. src/pages/__preview-* are build-time preview routes, NOT site routes, and are excluded.
routeCoverageNote: src/App.jsx mounts '/' (Home) plus every path in src/routes.js through src/pages/registry.js (families' index.js `pages` maps). verify_all.py::check_route_coverage asserts 1:1 coverage here and, when the source is present, against src/routes.js.

excludedPaths./__preview/*: build-time section previews registered by src/pages/__preview-*/index.js; not linked, not in src/routes.js.

layout.wrapper: root div: overflow-x-clip, bg-page (bg-content-bg on content-theme routes), pt-[4rem] clearing the fixed nav; Nav, <main>, Footer.
layout.rootFontSize: html.fluid-rem (fluid root) except FIXED_REM_PAGES, which keep 16px
layout.footerVariant: Footer variant 'home' (demo form) on '/' and '/company'; 'subpage' (demo CTA button) elsewhere
